$comment: Adits effects run unmodified by tools/fx/fx.mjs (rcg fx). params: Adits UI inputs (DOM ids) with their UI defaults; ranges: [min, max, step] so the harness makes real range inputs that clamp and snap as the Adits UI does; vparams: videoEngine.params; presets: Adits preset tables (core/main.js) applied over the defaults; needs/optional: src2 = a second media (side B); webgpu: needs a WebGPU device; options: harness behaviour (media "video" = a real seeked <video>; ready/settle = properties to wait for; bSpeedParam; tickHz = the host logic runs at this rate, Adits' display loop, and the scene renders once per output frame; such effects also get job.analyser, Adits' AnalyserNode emulated per tick, and job.track, the point from --track / --point). kind anamorphic = the footage as an AnamorphicCamera model over a background (rcgBackground auto | footage | src2 | black | none).

ghost.label: Ghost trails (AdvGhost): delayed copies screened in magenta and cyan; lag and offset follow the music

motion-trails.label: Motion trails (MotionTrails, ICM): long-exposure smear of the last frames; darken, lighten or smear; can isolate trails

origami.label: Origami (Origami): the frame folds into paper shapes (crumple, crane, heart, mandala...) over the transform time

heat-haze.label: Heat haze (HeatHaze, WebGPU): rising shimmer with grain and chroma split; desert, stove, jet exhaust, underwater

blow-pixels.label: Blow pixels (BlowPixels, WebGPU): pixels blow away in the wind; holes show black

frame-tunnel.label: Frame tunnel (FrameTunnel): frames sampled from the whole clip flown as a tunnel, rain, dominoes, globe, wormhole, flipbook, burn, shred or 3D gallery

reveal-under.label: Reveal under (RevealUnder, WebGL2): a lattice of cells reveals a second layer (side B, or an echo / freeze / zoom of the clip)

split-screen.label: Split screen (SplitScreen, WebGL2): linear split or shape mask (circle, star, heart, blob, bird, flower, leaf, smoke) between the clip and side B

smoke.label: Smoke (SmokeEnv, three.js): drifting smoke or jet plumes and low mist over the footage, optional text in the fog; --alpha renders the smoke alone

rain.label: Rain (RainSystem, three.js): streaks that refract the footage, wind, motion blur, colour modes, optional splashes on bright areas

holo-sheen.label: Holo sheen (HoloSheen, three.js): holographic foil (cyan/magenta band, rainbow, glitter) over the footage on a gently tilting plane

color-mask.label: Color mask (Adits Global Color Mask, chroma key, WebGPU): pixels near a picked colour show side B (--src2: another clip or an fx clip of the same footage) or a solid colour; tolerance, feather, invert

modes.media: reveal side B (or the bg colour) where the colour matches
modes.effect: side B (an effect clip) only where the colour matches, raw footage elsewhere
modes.color: side B (or the footage) where the colour matches, bg colour elsewhere

voxel-drop.label: Voxel Drop (VoxelDrop + Rapier physics): the footage as a grid of cubes that voxelize in a ripple and fall; styles drop / orbit / tunnel / bursts (presets); rcgDropAt / rcgBackAt press Drop and Back to Plane (seconds)

voxel-hole.label: Infinite Hole (VoxelDrop + Rapier physics): the cubes in a centre circle drop through and loop forever; the rest of the footage stays flat (Adits tilts to -50 on enable)

voxel-magnet.label: Magnet (VoxelDrop): cubes near a point swell and reach toward it (--track hand or face, or --point); anamMagnetInvert pushes; anamMagnetGesture: open palm pushes, fist pulls

voxel-flip.label: Flip (VoxelDrop): tiles flip 180 degrees about their centres: an elastic auto wave, the music (anamFlipAudio, --audio) or a hand (anamFlipGesture, --track)

voxel-grow.label: Grow (VoxelDrop): tiles extrude by brightness like a city skyline around a point (--track / --point; anamVoxelGrowRange 100 reaches the whole frame); anamGrowAudio pulses the heights with the music

voxel-art.label: Voxel Art (VoxelArt): the footage rebuilt as stacked-cube relief (brightness = depth), banded toon shading, black voxel outlines, re-voxelised every frame

particles.label: Particles (ParticleSystem): the footage as a cloud of image-coloured points on springs; 9 audio dance modes (anamParticleAudioEnabled, --audio); repel around a point (--track / --point); colours from the first frame as in Adits, rcgLiveColor follows the footage

magic-carpet.label: Magic Carpet (MagicCarpet): the footage as wind-blown cloth with a woven hem and torn edge: flying carpet, hanging banner or waving flag (presets)

cutout.label: Cutout collage (CutoutCollage, Canvas2D): the frame cut into offset paper pieces with shadow, border and tint (8 layouts as presets); trigger manual (rcgCutoutAt "t:1;t:0" latches, cut apart from the start) / timer / beat (--audio); parallax around a point (--track / --point)

global-visuals.label: Global Visuals (Adits main.js Global Post-Processing): RGB Colors (beat colour cycle), Neon (hue glow), BnW, Negative, Fisheye (fxFisheyeIntensity), Global Opacity (globalOpacitySlider); --audio for RGB / Neon

vj-scan.label: Depth Scan (VJ ScanFX): a lit pattern band sweeps through luminance depth; 7 Adits presets (--preset); the Global Visuals params apply too (deck after BnW / Negative, before Fisheye); --audio, --track / --point, --subject

vj-lights.label: Lights (VJ LightsFX): keeps what is lit, the rest goes to a void colour; 10 Adits presets (--preset); the Global Visuals params apply too (deck after BnW / Negative, before Fisheye); --audio, --track / --point, --subject

vj-lightshow.label: Lightshow (VJ LightshowFX): the luminance depth field graded and run as a DMX light show; 5 Adits presets (--preset); the Global Visuals params apply too (deck after BnW / Negative, before Fisheye); --audio, --track / --point, --subject

vj-beatwash.label: Beat Wash (VJ BeatWashFX): one coloured point light washes the frame on the beat; 4 Adits presets (--preset); the Global Visuals params apply too (deck after BnW / Negative, before Fisheye); --audio, --track / --point, --subject
